impact: ConnectionManager::createFromGroup($group, $table = 'servers') and createFromTags($tags, $table = 'servers') query 'group' and 'tags' columns on a table named servers. dply's servers table has neither column, so both throw 'column does not exist' when called with their defaults - as does DispatchesTaskRunnerToServers::dispatchToGroup/dispatchToTaggedServers, which pass the same default through. The default is inherited from the upstream task-runner package, whose servers schema had those columns. No production code calls them with the default today, so nothing is broken in practice, but the signature advertises a capability that cannot work as written. Either drop the default so callers must name a table, or map group/tags onto something dply's servers table actually has.
title: createFromGroup/createFromTags default to a servers table dply does not have
